scope: Reminders v2 (snapshot contract v2 §5, owner decision 8 Oct 2026): the production, fabric and accessory conditions of the actor's own DONE staged run are built once, one page per request (then a seal: counts equal the run's totals, set hash over the identity hash and every condition hash) and never change; each is labelled with the snapshot time. Before a local preview is claimed, and again when it is finished, the condition is rechecked now in the same transaction after the request, destination and episode locks: production need_now = snapshot need minus any increase of finished stock + WIP of the model and size (plan v2's rule); a product, policy or plan change needs a new analysis; a fabric need is held back when its material moved, was ordered or planned since the snapshot; receivables and payables are read now with the v1 readers. Any verdict but STILL_OPEN is recorded with its numbers and nothing is claimed (NOT_SENT); STILL_OPEN claims one preview per episode and policy. Delivery stays LOCAL_TEST_SINK; nothing is sent outside the ERP.
client: The staged view shows a reminders panel: prepare the conditions (progress per page), totals at the snapshot time, a filtered list, 'Periksa ulang sekarang', 'Buat pratinjau lokal' with the recheck verdict (resolved since the analysis: not billed), record or mark uncertain, receivables/payables read now, destination and policy forms for managers. The word 'terkini' is never used.
browser: Real Auth UI on desktop and mobile: one click starts the staged run; the reminders panel prepares the conditions, rechecks one production condition, saves a destination and policy, claims a local preview whose text states the snapshot time and the recheck; only v2 reminder RPCs are called; no 'terkini'; no horizontal scroll
synthetic_case: none; fixtures are the plan v2, fabric and receivable Native fixtures through the ordinary writers and real staged runs; one race holds the shared episode lock from a test session (labelled)
